- The bottom left corner (HP, equipped weapons, and cards) must be visible. For Co-Op, the bottom right corner must be visible as well.

categories.name: DLC
categories.rules:
- [Pусский](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11EEqRcQLu4IFqr_wvaBwfpA7CRc0EZujBQ1VIsJwLlo/edit#heading=h.wza472een65l) - @Facejif

Co-op rules:

- The run has to be played out by two players, one playing as Cuphead and the other playing as Mugman. Each player must use separate input devices.

- Player two must join before entering the first stage/boss (tutorial stage is considered a stage/boss)

- Joining during a stage/boss already in progress is not allowed. This includes the removal and rejoining of player two.

- No player can leave the screen for more than five seconds without being parried or revived. This is referred to as “The Five Second Rule”.

- Any boss fight needed to complete a run must be entered and completed by both players. If a knockout is achieved within the bounds of the five second rule, then the fight will be considered valid.

- Any non boss stage needed to complete a run must be entered with both players but does not need to be completed by both players. There will be no five second rule penalty applied to these stages. 

- There are two valid options for the resurrection of a player that reaches zero hp and becomes a ghost during the course of a boss fight. They are as followed:                                                       

• The living player must revive their partner's ghost by performing a parry within the area of play.

• The non living player may utilize a self revival by pressing “esc/start” at the cost of one HP from the living player. This method must be performed within the bounds of the five second rule.

- Sticky Ghosts are allowed to be utilized as long as the non living player's ghost is either visible, or the living player can prove the ghost has been successfully stuck within the area of play by using the ghost to perform a parry within the remainder of the fight. If a ghost can not be seen on screen and has not been proven to have been successfully stuck within the aforementioned time frame, the fight will not be considered valid and will need to be beaten again before continuing the run.

Online play through alternate means, such as Parsec, is allowed.

Co-op rules:

- The run has to be played out by two players, one playing as Cuphead and the other playing as Mugman. Each player must use separate input devices.

- Player two must join before entering the first stage/boss (tutorial stage is considered a stage/boss)

- Joining during a stage/boss already in progress is not allowed. This includes the removal and rejoining of player two.

- No player can leave the screen for more than five seconds without being parried or revived. This is referred to as “The Five Second Rule”.

- Any boss fight needed to complete a run must be entered and completed by both players. If a knockout is achieved within the bounds of the five second rule, then the fight will be considered valid.

- Any non boss stage needed to complete a run must be entered with both players but does not need to be completed by both players. There will be no five second rule penalty applied to these stages. 

- There are two valid options for the resurrection of a player that reaches zero hp and becomes a ghost during the course of a boss fight. They are as followed:                                                       

• The living player must revive their partner's ghost by performing a parry within the area of play.

• The non living player may utilize a self revival by pressing “esc/start” at the cost of one HP from the living player. This method must be performed within the bounds of the five second rule.

- Sticky Ghosts are allowed to be utilized as long as the non living player's ghost is either visible, or the living player can prove the ghost has been successfully stuck within the area of play by using the ghost to perform a parry within the remainder of the fight. If a ghost can not be seen on screen and has not been proven to have been successfully stuck within the aforementioned time frame, the fight will not be considered valid and will need to be beaten again before continuing the run.

Online play through alternate means, such as Parsec, is allowed.

- Timer starts on file select.
- Switching difficulties during the run is not allowed.
- All runs outside of Co-Op mode should be done in 1 player mode only.
- Runs must be completed in a single segment. Pauses are allowed, but the timer must remain running. If not, we will add the time in manually. This includes closing and re-launching the game.
- Menu Glitch is banned.
- Mugman Army is banned.
- For runs that use the load remover, select "Yes" for "Loadless?". If you run on console, or do not use the load remover, select "No"

- Controllers may be switched in the middle of a run, but may not be used at the same time.
- Third party software, other than keybinders, are not allowed. If using a keybinder, you must set it up to be 1-to-1. That is to say, an action must be linked to one and only one button. - You must provide a recording of the FULL run, including the full scorecard on the final boss.
- The bottom left corner (HP, equipped weapons, and cards) must be visible. For Co-Op, the bottom right corner must be visible as well.
- If using the load remover, the loadless timer must be visible in the recording at all times.
- In-game sound (defined as the sound effects) is required for all runs. This applies to full and IL runs. Music is optional.
- For ILs, recordings need to start before the player gains control and show the ENTIRE scorecard after the run.
- If the run doesn't start towards the beginning of the video (for example, there's multiple attempts before the run), please make a note in the description with a timestamp of where the run starts. Your run may be rejected if it doesn't present a timestamp in such a case, asking you to re-submit with a timestamp.
- The recording of the run should be of at least watchable quality, and not lag behind too excessively.
